testing_points: Systems of two linear equations in two variables

skillNames.systems-solution-count: Systems with no / infinitely many solutions

template.name: system_no_solution
techniques: parallel lines have equal slopes and different intercepts

concept: A linear system has no solution exactly when the lines are parallel and distinct: proportional coefficients, constants not in that ratio.

stem: In the system of equations below, $k$ is a constant.
question.prompt: For what value of $k$ does the system have **no** solution?

choices.label: B
choices.why: With $k = -3$, the ratios $\dfrac{6}{18}$ and $\dfrac{-3}{-3}$ are not equal, so the lines have different slopes and intersect at exactly one point.

choices.label: C
choices.why: With $k = -1$, the ratios $\dfrac{6}{18}$ and $\dfrac{-3}{-1}$ are not equal, so the lines have different slopes and intersect at exactly one point.
choices.rationale: Divides by the scale factor instead of multiplying.

choices.label: D
choices.why: With $k = 9$, the ratios $\dfrac{6}{18}$ and $\dfrac{-3}{9}$ are not equal, so the lines have different slopes and intersect at exactly one point.
choices.rationale: Sign error when matching the y-coefficients.

steps.title: No solution means parallel lines
steps.caption: **No solution** means the two lines never meet: they are **parallel**. Watch the **signs** when you match the equations.

steps.title: Shortcut: scale the coefficients
steps.caption: **Shortcut:** parallel lines have $x$- and $y$-coefficients in the **same ratio**.

steps.title: Check the constants
steps.caption: If the constants scaled by $3$ too, both equations would be the **same line**.

steps.title: See it: equal slopes
steps.caption: Solve each equation for $y$: both slopes are $2$, but the $y$-intercepts differ.

steps.title: The trap: the wrong sign
steps.caption: **The trap:** $k = 9$ has the wrong sign. The slopes are then $2$ and $-2$, so the lines cross.

solution.keyIdea: **No solution** means parallel lines: the $x$- and $y$-coefficients share one ratio, but the constants do not.
solution.summary: No solution means the lines are parallel and distinct. The x-coefficients scale by 3 (6 to 18), so the y-coefficients must too: k = -9. The constants do not scale the same way (3 is not 10), so the lines are different. Both have slope 2. With k = 9 the slopes would be 2 and -2, and the lines would cross.

meta.title_hook: When a System Has No Solution

timing.rule: first whole second at or after the end of the thinking countdown; never after the first spoken explanation sentence
